summary: 16.16 fixed-point division with explicit sign handling: takes the absolute value of the numerator a1, shifts it left by 16 to bring it onto the divisor scale, performs the integer division by a2, then re-applies the sign of the original numerator.

operations.description: Initialize the sign flag v2 to 0 and copy the numerator into v3 = a1.
Guard on a1 < 0: when negative, set the sign flag v2 = 1 and take the absolute value v3 = -a1 so the division works on an unsigned magnitude.
Shift the magnitude v3 left by 16 bits as a signed 64-bit value and divide by the divisor a2.
Guard on the sign flag v2: when set, negate the quotient before returning.
Return the signed quotient, either -result for a negative numerator or result for a non-negative one.

unresolved: Division by zero for a2 == 0 is undefined; the raw source has no guard for it.
The fixed-point scale (16 fractional bits) is implied by the shift and the sibling FixedPointMultiplyWithRounding function, but not stated in this packet alone.
